title: Fix OllamaChat Bot 409 Telegram Conflict
description: OllamaChat bot keeps crashing with 409 Conflict error. The grammy bot.start() conflicts when launchd restarts too fast. Need to either: (a) add exponential backoff retry, (b) use bot.stop() before exit, or (c) disable KeepAlive and use manual restart.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Read src/ollama-chat-bot.ts and understand the startup flow
Add proper error handling for 409 conflict with 30s+ delay before retry
Add bot.stop() in process signal handlers (SIGTERM, SIGINT)
Test: pkill bot, wait 5s, start again - should work without 409
Run CodeRabbit review - must pass (or create BUG if unfixable)
Commit: fix: BUG-101 resolve OllamaChat 409 conflict
